target.description: Information about the lodestone. Optional. If not set, this compass spins randomly.

pos.description: The integer coordinates of the lodestone.

dimension.description: The ID of the dimension of the lodestone.

tracked.description: If {{cd|true}}, the component is removed when the lodestone is broken. If {{cd|false}}, the component is kept. Defaults to {{cd|true}}.

lodestone_tracker.description: If specified, stores information about the [ [lodestone] ] this [ [compass] ] should point towards.
